wstep: There is no recipe here for peaches canned in syrup with bourbon or brandy.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Syrup helps keep the flavor, color and shape of the fruit, but it does not prevent spoilage.
Do not use this method for white-flesh peaches: some varieties are higher in pH, and there is no tested process or acidification for them.

akapity: NCHFP has a tested recipe for canning halved or sliced peaches in a boiling-water canner, for yellow-flesh peaches.
In that recipe the peaches are packed in very light, light or medium syrup, or in water, apple juice or white grape juice.
Bourbon and brandy are additions outside this tested recipe.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for peaches canned in syrup with bourbon or brandy from a checked source.
JarAtlas has a card for yellow-flesh peaches canned by the tested NCHFP recipe, without alcohol.
